name: donerelay
description: One local bundle for Telegram notifications, questions, and remote approvals in Codex and Claude Code; experimental WeChat support.

interface.shortDescription: Telegram updates and remote human approvals for AI agents
interface.longDescription: One local bundle for Codex and Claude Code with the complete Node.js runtime, guided private Telegram pairing, and automatic service startup. Receive notifications, answer bounded questions and approve or deny one exact operation. Node.js 22+ and a running agent on the same computer are required. Native permissions remain enforced. Experimental WeChat support; hosted runtime compatibility is not verified.
defaultPrompt: Use $donerelay to send me a concise Telegram notification when this task finishes.
Use $donerelay to ask whether staging is the correct deployment target; wait for my answer.
Use $donerelay to request approval for this exact operation. Keep native permission checks in place.
